title: Okulabula Okutonotono Nga Omugenyi Agenda Okutambula
intro: Muyingire mu kiwonvu omufuzi ow’amaanyi n’ekibinja ekinene ennyo mwe basemberera, era ekifaananyi ky’omutambuze omutono ng’awa okulabula okutaasa ekitundu kyonna. Ekitundu ekiri mu katyabaga bwe kituuka mu kifo we basula, akabi kayitawo. Goberera obubonero obulaga nti omuntu abuusibwa amaaso emabega w’okulabula okwo.
clues: Nze ndi mu bitonde ebitonotono ebikwatagana n’obwakabaka bw’omufuzi.
Ekitundu kyange kibeera mu maka agali munda mu kiwonvu, omu ku ffe gy’asobola okuyita abalala.
Tuyolekedde okutiisibwatiisibwa okuva eri omufuzi oyo n’amagye agatambula n’omufuzi oyo.
Nze ayita ekitundu kyange okuyingira mu maka gaabwe n’okutulabula obutabetentebwa nga tetumanyi.
Omufuzi ye Sulayman, era ekika kyange kiri mu bitonde ebiteekeddwa wansi w’obulagirizi bwe.
Nze enseenene y’ekiwonvu ekyo; oluvannyuma lw’okulabula kwange, twayingira mu maka gaffe ne tusimattuka okunyigirizibwa okwandibadde kutukutte nga tetumanyi.

outcome.label: Ebivudemu
options: Ekitundu kyawonye kubanga amagye gadda emabega
Ekitundu kino kyatwalibwa mu buwambe mu lubiri lw’obwakabaka

arabic: وَمَا كُنتَ تَتْلُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِهِۦ مِن كِتَـٰبٍۢ وَلَا تَخُطُّهُۥ بِيَمِينِكَ ۖ إِذًۭا لَّٱرْتَابَ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ
verse: And you did not recite before it any scripture, nor did you inscribe one with your right hand. Then [i.e., otherwise] the falsifiers would have had [cause for] doubt. (29:48)
